:::{#exm-matrix-analysis}
#### Eigenvalues of a small matrix

The [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}$ has the [eigenvalues](linear-algebra.qmd#def-eigenvalue)
```{r}
#| echo: false
eigen(matrix(c(2, 1, 1, 2), nrow = 2))$values
```
Finding these eigenvalues is a question about $\matr{A}$ alone, so it is a topic of [matrix analysis](#def-matrix-analysis).
<!-- no-figure: the example is two numbers -->
